items: 【Retro Console Table】With clean lines and a strong concave feel, the foyer table combines the beautiful styling of classicism with the practical functionality of neoclassicism. Add a touch of vintage flavor to your living room or hallway and enhance the overall beauty of your space. The minimalist design also pairs perfectly with sleek, rustic, country or farmhouse furniture decor.

【2 drawers & 2 Door Storage Cabinets】This entry table comes with 2 spacious drawers and 2 door storage cabinets, providing ample storage space for your belongings. And the bottom shelf is perfect for placing storage baskets or taller display items as additional storage. Flower bouquets, scented candles, photos, books or other items, everything has the right place to be displayed.

【Premium Material & Sturdy】The console table with storage is made of high quality MDF frame and woven rattan, so it has exquisite workmanship and smooth surface. The sturdy wood enhances safety and stability for durability. The back of the table has anti-tip fittings to keep the console table stable. Adjustable feet on the bottom of the table corners protect the floor and prevent the table from tilting.

【Versatile & Practical】This console table with drawers is perfect for use as a sofa table, foyer table, entry table, small TV table and coffee bar table. With the right size, this entrance table is perfect for living room, dining room, foyer, balcony, office and more. Save tons of space in your living space.

【Easy to Assemble】This small entryway table with storage is very easy to assemble. We offer clear and easy-to-read instruction in the box and marks all the spare parts to ensure the easy assemble for everyone. Please feel free to contact us if any problems or questions and we will give response and solution within 24 hours.
